scope: Saved experiments only; no new API calls or fit. Sources retained below. Cohorts not pooled.

forced27.method: Raw NVDA price return = fifth regular-session Close / first regular-session Open after decision_time - 1; entry session counts as one. Inclusive neutral band +/-1%.
forced27.brier_definition: Mean across cases of sum over up/flat/down of (predicted probability minus one-hot actual outcome)^2; range 0 to 2, lower is better.

high_probability_subset.definition: Maximum model probability >= 0.90; descriptive only, not a validated calibration estimate.

caveats: Small purposively selected historical sample from one stock; no broad prediction or calibration claim.
Model may know historical outcomes despite source-only instructions.
Duplicate and overlapping return windows are dependent; 27 cases are not 27 independent observations.
This window excludes announcement-day and overnight adjustment before the entry open.
Yahoo/yfinance data are a research data source and can be revised; downloaded data are archived.
Price return excludes cash dividends; no split occurred inside any scored window.
Constant baselines use the same labels and windows. They are not trading-profit simulations.

limitations: Small selected historical sample; known outcomes informed development.
One fresh control per case does not establish repeatability or statistical causation.
Missing expectations and market observations remain missing.
Conditional flow recognition is not evidence of actual orders or a guaranteed return.
The original next-session-open to fifth-session-close target excludes initial repricing.
Duplicate and overlapping windows are dependent; raw price moves are not causal news effects.

market_only_strong.caution: Few month blocks and historical text uncertainty; not a claim of independent or prospective observations.

training_prior.caution: Few month blocks and historical text uncertainty; not a claim of independent or prospective observations.

brier_difference_intervals.label: Original final: Jev + market minus market only
Original final: Jev + market minus training prior
Fresh final: selected direct Jev minus market only
